# September 2026 approval polls for Trump continue to wane in U.S., NC

Portrait of Iris Seaton Iris Seaton

Asheville Citizen Times

Sept. 8, 2026, 2:40 p.m. ET

 Recent national polls show President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped, with some as low as 30%.
 A High Point University poll found Trump's approval rating among North Carolina registered voters is 42%.
 Trump's current approval ratings are lower than his first-term average of 41%. [...] Most recent polls from Ipsos with Reuters surveyed 1,167 adults and found a 33% approval rating and a 63% disapproval rating, a net approval rating of -30 percentage points.

Among all poll respondents, 54% disapproved of the job Trump is doing as president and 31% approved. While Trump’s disapproval numbers in North Carolina have stayed roughly the same during 2026, his approval rating in this survey was the lowest recorded by the Elon University Poll since Trump took office in January 2025.

Stein had a 40% approval rating, a drop of 6% from the Elon University Poll conducted at the end of July. Stein’s disapproval numbers stayed steady at 25%.
